policy: This is an evidence ledger. Original J2ME level claims require verification against actual playable source. Do not fill missing metres with guesses.

sources.title: Metal Gear 2 Solid Snake character profile

facts.subject: Solid Snake
facts.scope: 1999 character profile; remaster 1995 physical reference remains provisional

facts.subject: 3D floor tile
